name: self-improvement
description: Allows Prometheus to audit its own performance, errors, and code quality to suggest and apply improvements.

audit_recent_errors.description: Analyze recurring error patterns in logs/errors/ and suggest proactive fixes.

limit.description: Number of recent errors to analyze (default 10)

analyze_code_complexity.description: Scan a file for high complexity (long functions, file length) and suggest refactoring.

file_path.description: Path to the file to analyze

generate_improvement_plan.description: Create a formal SELF_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md tracking proposed enhancements.

findings.description: The issues/suggestions found during auditing or analysis

cleanup_orphaned_processes.description: Find and terminate orphaned Prometheus processes (prom.js, web_server.js, mlx_lm) that are running in the background.

generate_daily_report.description: Generate a summary report of all self-improvement activities from the last 24 hours.

view_improvement_logs.description: Display the structured audit trail of self-improvement activities.

limit.description: Number of recent log entries to show (default 50)

run_performance_experiment.description: Run an iterative performance test (A/B testing) to measure LLM TTFT and TPS, with automatic outlier rejection. Use this to validate configuration changes.

prompt.description: The test prompt to use for benchmarking.

iterations.description: Number of times to run the test (default 10). Automatically rejects highest/lowest scores if >= 4.

log_improvement.description: Log a specific improvement attempt and its outcome (success/failure) for the audit trail.

activity.description: What was the improvement attempt? (e.g. 'Optimized weather logic')

details.description: Technical details, filenames, or error logs related to this attempt.
